We’re making some tweaks today to some of the Medium’s automatic and semi-auto weapons. These are aimed at two problems: Improving the Medium’s chances when dueling versus the now 175 HP Lights, and providing Mediums with more viable tracking aim options in their weapon pool.

While the argument could be made that some of this could also be achieved by nerfing Light weapons, Light still lags slightly among the archetypes across many skill tiers and modes, so we’d rather target this match-up specifically. Despite Heavy losing some HP in 12.0, it appears to have coped just fine with that change, in large part because of the wide array of defensive tools it has to protect itself against a more powerful Light. We feel these buffs to Medium will be similarly handled by the Heavy, but will allow Medium versus Light match-ups to be a little more balanced.

Among the changes, we’re shifting the FCAR back towards the direction it had earlier in the life of the game, as a slower firing but more punchy weapon, differentiating it slightly further from the AKM.

It’s worth noting that these changes are ‘tweakable’ changes, changes we can deploy without needing to patch the game client because they do not require new code or content such as audio, animations or VFX. In 12.3 an additional small round of balance changes will also come to the game that are done in support of this set of changes, but we didn’t feel we should wait for those before making these adjustments.

Hello.
We hope you are having a great time with CONTROL Resonant.

We have been very happy with the game's stability and overall technical performance during the launch window, based on the feedback we've received and the data we are seeing. However, there's always more to improve and fix, especially in a game of this size and ambition. Many things are much easier to see now that so many people are playing.
Game Update 1.40 brings many bug fixes for problems you likely never saw, fixes issues you have encountered, and adds additional polish across the game.
The update notes don't list every fix, but rather the ones we think make a difference for players. Or are just plain funny. The criteria keep changing as we go.
Lastly and very importantly, Game Update 1.40 brings quite a few quality-of-life improvements, so let's go over the highlights.
Highlights
New Game ++: You can now play an infinite number of runs of CONTROL Resonant in New Game ++

Added the Build Power number to the Loadout screen on the bottom left so that players can easily see their Power level instead of having to find it buried in the Stats & Effects menu: It's worth saying here that if you are below the enemy level, you are going to have a tougher time with combat, so keep doing side quests, explore twisted Manhattan, and level up!
The HUD will have a little notification icon to indicate that you have new things to buy or upgrade in The Gap

Added a feature that when you pin materials you need to acquire for upgrades, you can see if these materials are available at the Vendor by looking at the Vendor icon on the Map (instead of having to go to the Vendor to see their wares)
Unknown Zone - Decreased the overall amount of combat and intensity by 10%-15%
Added a separate volume slider for radio dialogue. You can now customize the audio balance between speakers/headphones and the DualSense controller speaker
Added a new option in the Assist Mode - Power Core Charge Duration: Added a 100-300% Power Core Charge duration multiplier
Many fixes to map markers either sticking around too long or being in the wrong place and not clearing correctly. We are sure we still missed a few of these, though
Fixed a VFX issue where framerate could drop during the Artist Resonant fight when she does her special attack
Added “Mute copyrighted music” option to turn off Apocalyptica’s “Upperhand” intro credits song (It’s a great track, so why would you)
Added a Tutorial about the Rush ability removing status effects
Fixed over-saturated HDR highlights in AgX (tonemapper)
Fixed a multitude of subtitle and VO issues across the game

Polish on all aspects of the game, including audio, dialogue timing, subtitle timing, animation, lighting, code, mission polish, UI, and so on
Added support for Razer haptics. The game will trigger many gameplay events like using melee, taking damage, etc., and trigger effects on Razer peripherals
We also should mention that AMD has released new optional drivers that improve performance and fix several game crashes. Please download the drivers here:
https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/release-notes/RN-RAD-WIN-26-9-2.html

Hello everyone,
Here is the latest Stardew Valley update for you. I hope you have been enjoying everything new in 1.6. Thanks for playing Stardew Valley!
-Ape ːstardropː
### New content & features
* If you lost an item that can't be found again, a new friend appears in the secret woods who can get it back (for a price).
* You can now put legendary fish in fish ponds. These are limited to one per pond and produce legendary fish roe. Each fish has a unique water color.
* You can now place beds and sleep inside any constructed buildings that allow furniture.
* Items dropped in water now float for a short time, so you can collect them if you're quick or have a magnet ring.
* Sam and Shane now have work portraits while working at JojaMart.
* Slightly tweaked some dialogues.
* Added new Easter eggs.
* Added hidden cheat commands
### Balance changes
* Blue grass no longer grows slower than normal grass.
* Fruit tree growth is no longer blocked by grass and seed spots.
* Pine trees now drop one extra wood when chopped down.
* The initiation quest now counts wild slimes killed on the farm.
* Thorns ring damage now stacks if you equip two of them, and monsters killed by a thorns ring now drop loot like regular kills.
* With the Gatherer skill, the chance to double harvested forage now applies when using an iridium scythe too.
* Son of Crimsonfish can now be caught during the night market.
* Robin no longer constructs buildings during green rain in year 1.
* Placing a bomb and then switching to a weapon no longer applies its enchantments to the bomb damage.

* Adventurer's Guild: Rusty Sword, Femur, Elf Blade, Steel Smallsword, Crystal Dagger, Obsidian Edge, and Work Boots. These unlock after you reach a certain mine level, regardless of whether you found them in a mine chest.
* Marnie's shop: Cow Decal.
* Hat mouse: Sports Cap.
* Willy's shop: Advanced Iridium Rod.
* Passing trains are now more likely to happen multiple times in the same session, but can no longer appear on consecutive days.
* Willy's shop now opens on spring 2 in the first year even if you didn't read his letter.
* Fixed Queen of Sauce reruns being affected by the recipes needed by unclaimed farmhands in empty cabins.
* Fixed being able to receive monster damage while jumping down a mine shaft before the screen fades to black.
* Fixed spa not fully recovering energy when a max-energy buff is active.
* Fixed sleeping late while exhausted not reducing stamina as intended.
* Fixed the catalogue and Furniture Catalogue selling items from themed catalogues like Retro Catalogue.
* Fixed exploit where a fish pond with a golden cracker could produce unlimited output. Fish pond output bonuses are now applied once when the output is created.
* Fixed exploit where you could cancel cow milking and still get the friendship boost.
* Fixed unintended extra chance of spontaneous green rain trees when loading a save in fall.
* Fixed skill buffs affecting shop item requirements in 1.6.
* Fixed sturdy ring no longer halving debuff times in 1.6.
* Fixed lower chance of catching lava eels in caldera after 1.6.
* Fixed forage crops harvested from garden pots always being low-quality and providing no XP.
* Fixed iridium scythe with forage crops not giving XP or applying the forage level quality boost.
* Fixed some weapons never dropping from crates when legacy randomization is enabled.
### Quality of life changes
* The game now recovers most saves automatically if they're broken, corrupted, or missing the `SaveGameInfo` file.

* The game now resends most achievements, recipes, and important mail if you somehow missed them. For PlayStation/Xbox players, [missed trophies are readded when perform a specific action instead](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Achievements#Retroactive_achievements).
* Fish ponds now show the number of roe or other output items to collect.
* The wedding event now replays if you exit & reload the day.
* The tailoring UI is now a bit more intuitive: slots that can't accept the held item are now disabled, and you can no longer pick up some items that can't be tailored.
* Colored items like flowers now also sort by color. That avoids items being reordered randomly each time you sort your inventory.
* You can now only sell books to the bookseller via the book purchase menu, not the trade-in menu. This reduces the chance of accidentally selling a book when trying to trade it in.
* The collections tab now shows artifacts, gems, and minerals once they're donated to the museum (not as soon as you find it).
* Clint now refills your watering can when upgrading it.
* Tweaked save process to reduce the chance of corruption.
* Anvils no longer accept parrot eggs if you can't re-roll their level yet.
* Chat commands are now case-insensitive.
* Changed `/help` format to make room for more commands.
* Added `/help` descriptions for `/emote`, `/mapScreenshot`, and `/unbanAll`.
* Added consistent messages when you can't use a multiplayer-only or host-only command.
* Performance optimizations.
### Technical changes
* Migrated from FAudio to OpenAL, which should improve performance when playing audio.
* Updated SDL from 2.0.x to 2.30.4 (used for input and windowing).
* Fixed compatibility with newer Windows systems when using some older GPUs.
### Gameplay fixes
* You can no longer swap a chest's type if the new type is too small to store its current items.
* NPCs no longer avoid passable terrain features like flooring and grass when pathfinding.
* Fixed kicking Krobus out of the house triggering divorce dialogues.
* Fixed Leo following his island schedule after moving to the mainland.
* Fixed a Lewis schedule where he would overlap Marnie.
* Fixed a Penny resort dialogue when married that was never shown.

* Fixed mom or dad sending duplicate mail if you change gender later.

### Multiplayer fixes
* Added an `/unlinkPlayer ` chat command, which lets the host player release a farmhand so it can be reclaimed by the next person who connects.
* Fixed being able to steal another player's roommate.
* Fixed farmhands able to claim multiple Desert Festival fishing quests per day.
* Fixed crash when reconnecting later in the day after leaving a festival.

* Fixed Willy not sending fishing rod mail to farmhands who join after spring 2.
* Fixed 'waiting for players' check including disconnecting players.
* Fixed trains not playing chugga chugga sounds for farmhands.
### Display text and localization fixes
* In the credits, replaced the Reddit/Twitter links with a "News & Community" link.
* Fixed a huge number of translation issues for non-English players, and added automated tests to keep translations more in sync going forward. For example, this fixes...
* dialogue/event changes in 1.6 which weren't applied in some languages;
* missing dialogues and event actions;
* missing, outdated, or incorrect translations;
* missing event preconditions (e.g. Leah's 10-heart event could play on a rainy day in some languages);
* events playing the wrong music, not being skippable, or placing players or NPCs at the wrong spot;
* translations having different dialogue portraits/breaks/etc;
* conversation topics not started when something happens;
* text being shown with one word per dialogue box;
* improved grammar (e.g. gender conjugation);
* various errors and typos;
* and many other issues.
* Many improvements and fixes to translations and sprites, including some re-translated item names.
* Renamed "cranberries jelly/juice/wine" to "cranberry jelly/juice/wine".
* Fixed some bad words being produced by the random name generator.
* Fixed NPC text signs and some chat/UI messages in multiplayer not always shown in your language.
* Fixed flavored items in some chat/UI messages not shown correctly (like "Player put 'Smoked' into the potluck soup").
* Fixed various typos in English text.
* Fixed special order objectives not re-translated when the language changes. (This fix only applies to new special orders going forward.)
* Fixed Robin showing the wrong number of hardwood required for a house upgrade in some languages.
* Fixed some languages showing Willy's back room invite mail as "???" in the collections tab.
* Fixed some languages having inconsistent hat hair behavior.
* Fixed some languages producing items with a different internal name.
* Fixed French players not seeing prismatic effect for Magic Cowboy Hat and Magic Turban.
* Fixed French and Japanese showing a 'needs 5 coal' message for the dehydrator.
* Fixed Russian club coin and slots offset issues.
* Fixed Russian Joja movie theater tilesheet not showing up.
* Fixed Russian tool tooltips having overlapped names.
* Fixed Spanish jukebox showing blank name for 'Ginger Island' song.
* Fixed buy-ticket messages showing an unformatted price (like 1000g instead of 1,000g).
### Cosmetic fixes
* Added lights to Marcello's book stand.
* Sam now changes uniform when he enters JojaMart, instead of only when he reaches his work tile.
* Fixed many bugs related to light sources (e.g. lights stuck on screen, shown in the wrong location, removed before they should be, etc).
* Fixed issues with the golden walnut & Qi gem drop-down display:
* Added support for showing both at once (e.g. another player finds a golden walnut while you're in the Qi gem shop).
* Fixed display sometimes stuck on screen permanently.
* Fixed display showing the wrong type in some cases.
* Fixed display sometimes appearing in multiplayer when the value didn't change.
* Fixed line wrapping for movie concession description tooltips.
* Fixed visual glitch during the even-year Spirit's Eve if you have the Joja movie theater.
* Fixed issue with padding on the edge of maximized game windows on Windows.
* Fixed a shirt that looked weird.
* Fixed tooltip display issues, like an empty space for edible items that don't recover any stamina/health (like sweet pea and crocus) or an unintended double space in tooltip buff names.
* Fixed missing shadows behind some colored items (like wine) in menus.
* Fixed texture wrapping issue with Joja door.
* Fixed glitched hidden emote animations in NPC profile menu in some cases. NPCs now use always their default sprite in the profile view.
* Fixed red slime item sprite drawn one pixel lower than other colors.
* Fixed missing pixels in anvil sprite's outline.
* Fixed stray pixel in dried mushroom color mask.
* Fixed Krobus showing a gift icon for the void ghost pendant when he can't accept it.
* Fixed the item-received message cutting off part of the item name if it contains a `#` character (like 'Tropical Fish #173').
* Fixed the item-received message sometimes showing no count or a wrong count.
* Fixed some farm animals having double shadows.
* Fixed stardrop tooltips showing incorrect health/energy recovery amounts.
* Fixed timing of Easter egg in summit event.
### Gamepad fixes
* Fixed various issues/crashes with gamepad support.
* When buying animals or buildings with a gamepad, you can now use the D-pad to move the cursor.
* In the community center bundle UI, using gamepad triggers to move to donation slots and back now returns you to the same spot.
* Added a small delay before you can cancel a waiting-for-players dialogue using a gamepad, to prevent accidentally closing it immediately after pressing the OK button.
* Fixed gamepad issues on the new game screen.
* Fixed dresser tabs not selectable with a gamepad.
### Changes for modded players
* Added a `Content/ContentHashes.json` file containing the MD5 hash for every vanilla content asset. This can be used by SMAPI and other tools to detect corrupted or modified game files.
*Improved debug console commands.
* When you leave a horse/mount in a temporary location, it now returns home when that location is removed.
* Fixed 'Jewels Of The Sea' book producing roe for custom fishing catches that normally don't have roe.
* Fixed forage crops outside the farm being removed each week.
* Fixed meteorite, strange capsule, and stone owl only appearing in the top-left 64x64 tile area on large custom farm maps.
* Fixed pagination in powers tab when mods add more powers.
* Fixed edge cases throughout the game code related to items whose stacks can't be reduced to zero (e.g. tools).
* Fixed various errors when custom items have no name.
* Fixed error when mods apply audio changes if there's no audio device available.
* Fixed error if there are no movies available due to a mod bug. The game will now log a warning and choose from the full list of movies instead.
* Fixed crash if a farm animal is in a broken building or location.
* Fixed crash if a smoked fish's original fish data no longer exists. You now get a delicious smoked Error Item instead.
* Fixed crash when custom sounds loaded from a mod's `.ogg` files are paused/resumed many times.
* Fixed map tilesheet crash in some cases when playing split-screen mode with mods.
* Fixed issues when the game's `whichFarm` and `whichModFarm` fields are out of sync.
* Fixed 'light source already exists' and 'changing net field parent' warnings in some cases.
* Fixed mod data getting reset on chest type swap.
* Fixed berry bushes showing wrong sprite in locations where seeds can be planted in any season.
* Fixed stardrop gift reaction dialogue for custom NPCs defaulting to some raw data instead of their loved dialogue.
* Fixed able to enter the Adventurer's Guild back room without meeting the requirement if the door is open after a custom event.
* Fixed triggered actions being logged twice.
### Changes for mod authors
* See the 1.6.9 mod author migration guide for new APIs, dialogue keys, game state queries, debug commands, map properties, C# constants/fields/methods, data fields, and many other technical changes.

Here is the latest patch, which includes some new content, as well as a bunch of balance changes, quality of life features, translation improvements, and bug fixes.
New content & features
– Added 20 new ‘alternate’ mine layouts, which can start appearing after reaching the bottom of the mines.
– Added 20 new volcano mines layouts, which can appear after you’ve unlocked the shortcut between the caldera and the volcano entrance.
– Added fish frenzies.
– Added a special cutscene after you’ve helped your new neighbors grow their family to the max.
– Added 4 new fairy styles.
– You can now place 8 additional non-fish items into fish tanks.
– Raccoon shop now includes a trade for mystery boxes and golden mystery boxes.
– Vinegar can now be poured onto trees to stop them from ever growing moss.
– Shaving enchantment now causes tree-specific drops: (fern → fiddlehead fern, mushroom → red mushroom, mahogany → hardwood)
Translation changes
– Many edits and improvements to the Chinese version
– Edits to the Russian, Portuguese, Hungarian, Turkish, and Korean translations.
– Changed the Chinese fonts to make them more appealing and readable.
– Changed Hungarian number spacing character from a comma to a period.
– Some improvements to Russian font.
Balance changes
– When you load a save, you’ll now unlock missed Steam achievements if needed (e.g. achievements gained while playing offline).
– Added mini-shipping bin as an expensive Qi gem shop purchase.
– Added more variety, and improvements, to Skull Cave treasure chests.
– Life elixirs now only restores health, and energy tonics now only restore energy.
– Wild seed spots are now rarer, but yield more seeds.
– Doubled the Iridium Golem’s chance to drop iridium.
– The monsters in the volcano entry level are now randomized each day.
– Using a treasure totem indoors no longer works. This prevents them from being wasted.
– Going down a level in the mines now makes you invulnerable for 1 second.
– Increased raccoon mystery box reward from 4 to 5.
– Farming experience now contributes to mastery experience at a 50% rate.
– Ice orb will no longer freeze a spider while it is in the air jumping.
– Removed red snapper from winter fishing quest pool, and sardines from the summer quest pool.
– You will no longer get calico rating points from going down the normal mines.
– Golden mystery boxes now have a small chance to yield an auto petter.
– Slightly reduced chance to find mystery boxes.
– Mine barrels and coal carts will now “refresh” at the start of each year.
– The order of mystery box rewards is now randomized per-player instead of per-save.
Visual improvements
– Qi club coins now show up in the shop menu.
– Various map edits and fixes.
– Removed Maru’s glasses from all beach portraits for consistency.
– Improvements to signage in some non-english languages (i.e. Chinese, French, and Russian)
Quality of life changes
– Added a 1.2-second delay after dropping an item, before it’s picked back up by the same player.
– Napalm rings are now non-destructive on the farm and inside the slime hutch (i.e. the explosion will only damage monsters).
– Added ctrl + right-click as an alternate toolbar drop hotkey.
– Receiving a “special notification” (e.g. first geode message) will no longer cancel out player actions such as eating or warping.
– Flopping fish no longer fall back into fish ponds.
– Crab pots now have a short time period after harvesting from them during which they can’t be removed (750ms).
– The Junimo bundle menu now only highlights items that can actually be placed in the selected bundle.
Other changes
– Minor optimizations.
– Added two inappropriate names to the list to exclude from the name generator.
– You can no longer give gifts to NPC’s during green rain year 1 (prevents incongruous attitudes). This also prevents a portrait issue with Demetrius.
Gameplay fixes
– Fixed disappearing pets bug.
– Fishing splash zones and ore pan points are now removed overnight.
– The prize ticket machine now consumes your ticket when you get the reward, rather than when you first press the button.
– For the purposes of perfection, the level 100 mines stardrop now has a more robust way to check if it’s been acquired.
– Fixed Monster Compendium not actually doubling all loot.
– Fixed geodes no longer dropping on the farm in normal circumstances.
– Fixed rare crash when spawning items overnight.
– Fixed player colliding with stuff during event cutscenes.
– Fixed pre-1.6 forged weapons having reduced stats.
– Fixed not being able to put a torch on the sprinkler you get as a CC reward.
– Fixed various bugs/crashes related to building a cabin.
– Fixed wild seeds in garden pots putting their final crop in the top-left corner of the map instead of the pot.
– Fixed “lost and found” chests (from night market and elsewhere) not working anymore in 1.6.
– Fixed a duplication bug with the “lost and found” chests.
– Fixed slime hutch floors reverting to the default after reloading a game.
– Fixed malformed casino shop red fireworks ID.
– Fixed pet adoption catch-all case only working with the animal catalogue, and only applying in year 2 specifically, rather than for any year 2 or beyond.
– Fixed ‘use legacy randomization’ option applied inconsistently when loading a save, which caused weird issues like broken green rain days.

– Fixed the case where you could permanently miss the ancient seed recipe if you grabbed the ancient seed packet but not the associated recipe, and then closed the museum rewards menu. Missing recipes will also be restored upon loading a file.
– Fixed issue with duplicated animals & building interiors from pre ~1.3 saves.
– Fixed end tables not being rotateable.
– Fixed an issue where empty barns/coops could not be removed by Robin on old saves.
– Fixed slime egg incubators letting you reclaim the egg before it hatches.
– Fixed farmhouse placement bounds to match the object placement restrictions around it.
Multiplayer fixes
– Synced some NPC Gift data in other languages.
– Fixed fireworks (and possibly other sprites) drawing behind stuff in multiplayer.
– Fixed “Build a Silo” quest not being completed for farmhands.
– Fixed Raccoon quest not being removed for all players.
– Fixed double trinket issue when a farmhand disconnects/reconnects.
– Fixed double and/or missing derby participants sprite issue in multiplayer.
Display text and localization fixes
– Many edits and fixes in translation text.
– Fixed a text parsing error for Asian languages which caused them to incorrectly wrap in some cases.
– Fixed spacing issues in Asian languages.
– Fixed several localization issues
– Fixed Russian line break issue.
– Fixed events not consistently handling gender-dependent text.
Cosmetic fixes
– Adjusted the draw order of basic objects so that debris will not be drawn underneath them as often.
– Placeable grass now offsets vertically a little if it would clip through a front-layer tile.
– Fixed seasonal world map not working for non-English players.
– Fixed flying monsters not being draw above things on the farm & volcano.
– Fixed reward icon in completed quest menu being visually offset.
– Fixed george’s TV clipping with farmer during green rain.
– Fixed movies not showing layered sprites (e.g. the eyeball in Mysterium).
– Fixed Qi club coins drawn below the lightmap.
– Fixed Qi coin overlay drawn during minigames.
– Fixed crane game audio not stopping when the game is forcefully closed.
– Fixed some tooltip padding issues.
– Fixed movie theater display issues on the world map.
– Fixed repeated dialogue selection sound if a control was plugged in but you are using a mouse.
– Fixed quest reward icon input offset issue.
– Fixed Joja Warehouse roof drawing above the weather (and possibly other similar cases).
– Fixed various map tile issues.
– Fixed a visual issue with a shadow in the farm house.
– Fixed able to swap two chests of the same type.
– Fixed machines sometimes wobbling when they’re not processing anything.
There are also some changes for modded players and mod authors, if those are of interest to you, check the full patch notes here or here.
Thank you for playing Stardew Valley!

This patch introduces two new features and several improvements to Slow Motion in order to make Star Wars Jedi: Survivor accessible to even more players.
A new high contrast mode allows players to desaturate the environment and use colors specifically for narrative and gameplay elements, making them stand out more.
A new audio ping functionality allows players to both passively and actively ping the environment, giving the ability to echolocate objects and interactable elements nearby.

This will allow users to switch between multiple different slow motion values, and not just the custom value and the default game speed.

The wait is over, The Dark Horizon DLC is available September 24th! Discover hidden secrets, explore new dungeons, collect powerful gear, encounter unexpected allies, and face fresh dangers as you strive to solve the mystery of The Dark Horizon.
Introducing the Warden Archetype!

Boss Rush is the ultimate game mode for players who crave non-stop action and boss battles.

RoN Update v1.5.3 addresses many crashes and performance improvements across all platforms. Fixes for the Mission Editor, failures to authenticate to Epic Online Services on PS5, and issues with laser or flashlight attachments emitting from misaligned positions from weapons are also among the changes made.
Q: ‘My game mods broke on PC with this update, why did that happen?’

> A: When Ready or Not or games in general release updates to the game, the files for the game in areas related to new game content or fixes then changes. If mods were using the old files to function that have since changed to new files, those mods will likely need to update in order to work properly with the new version of the game’s files.
Ready or Not Modding Update Tips: https://voidinteractive.net/community-resources/
Q: ‘Why does an update download initially seem frustratingly large in data/gigabytes, even when the game doesn’t actually take up that much more storage when the download finishes’

> A: Game service platforms such as Steam etc. may update games by overwriting the game's files with the new files to replace it. For example, this means a update download that initially shows as 6GB during the download may actually only expand the game by 1GB in size, since it is largely just overwriting old game files for the other 5GB of data.
Q: ‘Why does an update take so long to download despite my fast internet’

> A: Other routine checks that a game service platform does to confirm game file integrity on the local storage device (e.g. your hard drive such as a HDD or SSD) during an update download can extend the perceived download size/time.
Q: ‘Why didn’t my game update yet on my console platform?'
> A: Console platforms do not necessarily support auto-updates, so you may have to trigger the update manually within your game library with an internet connection.

This update is a big one for us here at Starbreeze because we went into this year with the goal of providing you all an anniversary to remember.

From the new ways to unlock content, the upgrade to Unreal Engine 5, the improvement to our Tutorial, and now with our revamped Campaign and removal of paid Heist DLC - these are all geared towards how we will steer the game, with all of you, into the future. And we're excited for what comes next! But mostly, we're excited for you all to experience everything on offer in this Anniversary update.
Thank you for going on this journey with us during the year. Happy Anniversary!

When writing a brand-new story for PAYDAY 3, we avoided changing too much in the heists themselves and focused on creating a wraparound for every heist to recontextualize the game and its premise.

We establish Shade and her relationship with the gang, explain why not every heister is back committing crimes with the gang. And provide a stronger reason for returning to the job in the first place.

Better yet, we’ve created a system that lets us create new campaigns in the future. Still weaving them through existing heists, that means that we will have the opportunity to add new campaigns and tell different stories by combining new and old heists and events.
We hope you enjoy it!

But what about more customization? Weapon perks are powerful abilities added to your weapons. They’re added from the weapon mods menu and can completely change how your build works. Each weapon class (assault rifle, SMG, etc) has its own perks; be sure to check them all out.

Perks can be equipped or persistent. Equipped, shown in blue with a hand icon, means it works when you’re holding the item. Persistent, shown as a green icon with a holster, works at all times like a passive ability. Make sure to use both and become unstoppable!
We’ve seen the feedback on the iconic weapons, and we agreed: They didn’t have a clear purpose in the game, especially following the removal of weapon XP.
To really make these guns stand out, we’ve given them either a perk from another weapon class or a completely unique one.

Several weapon mods previously exclusive to certain weapons have been made shareable, meaning they’ll be usable on more weapons than they were before. More bang for your buck and another tool to unlock the full potential of your dream build.

With the release of the OVE9050, we’re adding the ability to customize Overkill Weapons. This means that in addition to the very powerful perks, you’ll be able to equip unique skins, paint, add stickers and charms to them in order to ensure your most powerful tool doesn’t clash with your getup.
We’ve made a lot of changes to how you can customize your build in this update, so it makes sense to add a place for you to test your new loadout.

The shooting range is accessible through the main play button in the main menu. Here, you can test your damage against targets at different ranges, conveniently switch loadouts, and do some A/B testing if you’re trying to finalize that new build you’ve been working on.

Point, wave, or gesture. You can now customize your character's emotes in the emote menu under loadout. Express yourself, or express your dissatisfaction at your enemies, or flip off your friends, you decide.
Sprays, weapon patterns, and mask patterns are no longer consumable. You can now buy these items using in-game cash, and use them as many times as you’d like.

Last month, we made all DLC heists free. As part of that, we promised we’d provide unique compensation items for all the players who’ve supported us this far. They’re included in this update, and frankly, look amazing. Thanks for sticking with us this far. Wear these new masks as a badge of honor going forward. We salute you.

We have disabled .pak file signature verification in the project. This step allows the game to load unsigned/custom .pak files instead of rejecting them, and enables a much simpler pipeline for creating custom content such as skins, masks, and other visual assets.
Fixed an issue with controller deadzone settings, causing it to never be below 0.2 even though the settings said it was lower.
Safe doors will now pass through players if a player moves into their path while they are opening.
RFID readers will now turn grey once they can no longer be interacted with.
Fixed an issue where interrupting a human shield takedown could leave the player stuck.
Fixed an issue where players could become stuck in a deployable equipment state while casing, preventing actions such as sprinting.
The FBI antenna can now be damaged with the baseball bat in addition to the saw.
Reflector shields will now correctly blind players again.
Fixed an issue where weapon ammo information would not update correctly when changing mods.

Fixed an issue where the ATK7 would not correctly eject ammunition during reloads and could incorrectly retain a round in the chamber. The ATK7 Quick Mag now also has the same ammo pickup rate as its other magazines.
Players can now shoot open safe deposit boxes.
Zappers will now die when their battery is detonated.
Fixed an issue where Nader would get stuck while navigating certain areas, such as when rappelling or crawling.
Fixed an issue where using the legacy controller button layout occasionally caused inputs to be registered twice.
Slightly reduced the number of enemies that spawn across all difficulties.

Improved enemy coordination during assaults, with enemies now forming larger squads and attacking from more focused directions. Most special enemies will also gravitate towards groups, making them harder to isolate.
Fixed an issue where killing enemies at longer distances would not properly contribute to the assault intensity.
HEAT decay now starts 2.5 seconds earlier.
Fine-tuned assault pacing on lower difficulties so combat intensity builds up more gradually.
Fixed an issue where SWATs would look at their targets through walls, floors, ceilings etc.
Slightly faster cop and SWAT speeds
Rebalanced Snipers to specialize in breaking armor. Their health damage has been reduced from:
100 to 30 on Normal
100 to 38 on Hard
200 to 50 on Very Hard
300 to 50 on Overkill
Their armor damage multiplier has been increased to x3.
On Very Hard and Overkill, Snipers now also take one second longer to line up their shots, giving players more time to react.
The dozer faceplate is now about 50% harder to crack.
An estimated 22 -> 33 shot increase using the CAR-4.

Rebalanced Zapper and Nader's weak points. The Nader weak point explosion radius against players has been reduced from 500 to 350, while the explosion can still damage nearby enemies for up to 520 base damage with falloff over distance. The duration of being tased after destroying a Taser's weak point has also been reduced from 6 seconds to 3 seconds.
Cloakers will now throw a gas grenade instead of shooting at players they cannot reach, giving them a new way to pressure targets from a distance.

Naders are now more aggressive with their throwables. Their grenade cooldown has been reduced from 15 seconds to 3 seconds, their throwing animation is faster, and they can now also throw Frag Grenades.
Increased Nader survivability by giving them more health and additional ammo plates.
Players can now rotate farther while tased, giving them more freedom to react and fight back.
New grenade build balance
The aim was to retain the power of grenades, while balancing in-the-moment and total amounts of throwables that players gain access to throughout a heist.
Starting grenade amount - 3 -> 2
Replenishment of throwables from ammo bags: 3 -> 2
Base damage increased from 350 -> 552 within 2 m, with an additional distance bracket of 2.5 with damage 350
Bombs Away Base: damage bonus 7.5% -> 2.5%
Stockpile: Frag grenades Aced - additional grenades 3 -> 2
Sudden Impact Aced: additional Frag grenades 3 -> 2
Mad Bomber Base: chance to restore 1 grenade 25% -> 15%
Mad Bomber Aced: reworked - now secondary grenades are Flashbangs, that do not have a chance to restore a grenade, and are influenced by skills in the Flashpoint skill branch
Munitions Expert Aced: instead of accumulative replenishment based on the amount of invested skill points, the skill increases the amount of throwables restored by an ammo bag charge by 1
Ammo Up 1 Aced: additional charges 2 -> 1
Utility Belt Base: total throwables increase 2 -> 1
Utility Belt Aced: total throwables increase 5 -> 2
Premium Bag Base: amount of granted throwables 2 -> 1
Fixed an issue where Sunburn, Sunburn Aced, and related flashbang skills stopped functioning after the Unreal Engine 5 update.
Munition Expert Aced now grants a fixed bonus instead of scaling with the number of skill points invested.
Frag Master Aced grenade clusters now spawn Flash Grenades, which can benefit from other compatible skills.
UI
Updated item backgrounds to improve icon readability.
Moved mod information to the right side of the screen so related information is displayed together.
Added interaction text when deploying road spikes.
Updated several item icons to display at a higher resolution.
Added new background artwork to vendors' screens.
Updated Crimebond logos and naming to better reflect their content.
Removed the "Beta" label from Solo Mode.
Improved Crimebond navigation, including fixing the shop back button so it correctly returns to the DLC store.
Added an animation to the black market inspection screen.
Added the "mark enemy" input to the controller reference while viewing through cameras.
Fixed an issue where some player names could appear as "User content blocked."
Fixed an issue where the lobby could continue displaying the "Any" tactic after the host changed it.
Weapon description panels in the inventory can now display sight and perk information.
Weapon charms and stickers are now equipped through the mods menu instead of the cosmetics menu.

Added a burst of money when bags land and restored the leaking money trail on dyed bags.
Improved bag physics so bags behave more naturally when moving and landing.
Adjusted the sight positioning on the Skogskrigare AG-9.
Added additional sound effects to destructible objects such as cans, glasses, cups, vases, and fruit.
Enemy Gunfire Sound Changes - Created individual gunfire sounds for each cop and SWAT type.
Added cone attenuation to Cops and SWAT gunfire - Easier to hear when you're being fired on.
Added Individual Gunfire sounds and cone attenuation to Crew AI.
Most heists have had VO, and text has been changed to accommodate the new story and campaign mode. We won’t mention them all here to not overfill the changelog.

Added a pocket drill to the workshop door when the heist goes loud. Also fixed the flare objective appearing before any loot had been collected.

Fixed an issue where pedestrians outside could detect masked players through the large ground-floor windows during stealth. These windows can once again be seen through normally once the heist goes loud.
Added a counter to the optional "Steal All Loot" objective so players can see how many bags remain.
Fixed an issue where deployable tools could not be placed on certain surfaces.
Ziplines can now be used again.
The "No Stone Unturned" challenge now correctly counts bags being carried when the heist is completed.
Fixed an issue where the armored transport could end up sideways on the final ramp.
Improved the piano interaction area and added the correct localized interaction prompt.
Fixed an issue where players could become stuck behind the breached doors in Mason's office.
Fixed an issue where Mason could incorrectly become outlined on Normal difficulty when near the couches.
Fixed an issue where the poison could appear on Normal difficulty despite not being required.
Fixed an issue where Overkill Weapons could be delivered out of reach when called from the staircase.
Fixed an issue where Mason could continue speaking over the PA after being killed.
Fixed an issue where Mason remained outlined on Normal difficulty after the alarm was triggered.
Fixed an issue where the waypoint for preplanning C4 would fail to appear after going loud if the panic room had already been discovered.
Fixed an issue where secure-loot waypoints could remain after all loot, including the cat figurines, had been secured.
Fixed an issue where guards could see players through a blacked-out window that players could not see through.
Fixed an issue where the elevator could close during the preplanning thermite setup, potentially softlocking the heist.
Fixed an issue where the endless assault could begin too early, making bag extraction significantly more difficult than intended.

Made several quality-of-life improvements, including a visible 10-second computer hack, an interactable safe code, a keypad waypoint after finding the code, improved lure visibility, additional voice lines, and more body disposal locations.
Adjusted the blue keycard search behavior so guards now search only the rotunda and hallway. The waypoint remains active in loud to ensure players can still locate the keycard when needed.

Combining the Haymaker weapon perk and the Hidden Blade skill causes a conflict, resulting in the throwing knife being consumed without killing the enemy.

Emote preview won’t show secondary items, such as the coin in a coin flip.

items.text: Starting today, October 15, It Takes Two now supports online cross-play between PC, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch 2.
We’ve heard you asking for this one for a while, and we’re thrilled to finally make it happen. Simply update your game to the latest version, and you’re good to go!
Happy playing!
\[Patch Introduction]
New Weapon: Lancaster

A four barreled, medium ammo pistol with a rotating firing pin which allows for a high fire rate. Favored by Hunters on safari as a self-defense weapon due to its superior reliability and stopping power. Opening the break-action will always eject all rounds.
Basic - 4/12
High Velocity - 4/8
Poison - 4/12
Can be dual-wielded.
New Variant: Lancaster Cleaver
A variant of the Lancaster with an under-barrel blade, changing its melee attacks to be similar to a Heavy Knife in both swing pattern and damage.
Basic - 4/12
High Velocity - 4/8
Poison - 4/12
Can be dual-wielded.
World
All Bileweaver Infested Compounds (new and Old) will have a chance to spawn in Chapter 3. There will be 5 compounds active per game.
Fair Play Follow Up
Players get a follow up notification when a player they reported was banned
Players get a Hunt Dollar refund when they get killed by a player who was banned
High ping queue (Temporary test in Europe for the duration of Chapter 3)

Players get matchmade into a separate queue if their ping is above a threshold. The goal is to reduce exposure to high-latency gameplay. Should they not be able to find a match, they rejoin the regular matchmaking queue.
\[Upcoming Updates]
New Community Event: “Reap the Harvest”

“Reap the Harvest” is a new Community Event that is planned to start later in Chapter 3. The Community Event will consist of 5 Stages, each offering a reward to the whole of the community. Players will progress the Community Event by earning Community Event Points which is done by completing objectives in matches.
Community Event Stage Rewards
Stage 1: 5K Hunt Dollars & 1K Event Points
Stage 2: Lancaster (New Weapon)
Stage 3: 10K Hunt Dollars & 2.5K Event Points
Stage 4: Lancaster Cleaver (New Weapon)
Stage 5: Random Legendary Skin

The Inferno Time of Day is back to Hunt, bringing wildfires raging across all maps. It comes with reduced visibility due to heavy smoke and wildfires in affected areas. Wildfires are fixed in location, blocking key traversal paths and forcing new route planning. AI will generally avoid wildfire zones, but if necessary, enemies may follow players through the flames or take shortcuts across them. Inferno will remain part of the active Time of Day Rotation throughout Chapters 2 and 3.
Firefighter Supply
This type of supply only appears during the Inferno Time of Day.
Find valuable rewards such as the Flame Rifle, Scouting Map, or Tarot Cards.
Flame Rifle
Scarce Weapon that releases pressurized liquid producing a steady burst of flames.
They are guaranteed to be found at the Firefighter Supply
The All Hallow’s Cleave Community Event consists of 5 Stages. Players will progress the Community Event by earning Community Event Points which is done by completing objectives in matches.
Stage 1: New Tarot Card: The Atlas
Reveals all hidden locations on the map.
Stage 3: New Tarot Card: The Temperance
Restores the last Trait lost by your hunter this mission.
Dev Note: Using the card also returns traits lost to Siphon, not just burn traits.
Stage 5: New Tool: Long Derringer
A small single-shot pistol that fires Long Ammo, which deals high damage with a reduced velocity and short drop range. More accurate from short to medium range.
The Flame Rifle will come in handy as the Bileweavers are making their comeback in Chapter 2. They have infested 20 new Compounds across all maps, 5 of which will be selected for each match.
We are also introducing their deadlier relatives, the Bloodweavers.
They are Bileweaver variations that cause Bleeding damage with their jump attack and egg-hatching.
Players can identify them by their red-colored body.
The color of Bileweaver Eggs has changed to better reflect their poisonous nature, and Bloodweaver Eggs inherit the red-colored ones with spikes.
They are only present during the Blood Moon Time of Day.
Bileweavers, Bloodweavers, and the infected new Compounds will all arrive with All Hallows’ Cleave on Oct 13th.

Thank you all for your excitement and hype since the reveal of Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen! We’ve really enjoyed reading through your comments, thoughts and theories and look forward to welcoming you back to Vermund and Battahl, as well as the frosty Norgan region on October 9. Read on to find out why there’s never been a better time to dive into – or rediscover – the original Dragon’s Dogma 2!
Firstly, in case you missed it, the announcement trailer gives a taste of what to expect from the upcoming expansion:

Within Norgan, an evolved version of the original Dark Arisen’s signature loot-driven gameplay can be found! To get you prepped for your adventures there, we’ve prepared an overview video on the game’s loot-based Relic Expedition Cycle, check it out below:
Norgan is full of powerful treasures, just waiting to be discovered!

Arise Again marks a special moment for Dragon’s Dogma 2. With Title Update 3.2 now live, including optimisation improvements, lots of quality-of-life additions like the increasing of your skill slots from 4 to 6, increased save slots and save system adjustments, Dragonsplague changes (making it easier to notice when a Pawn is afflicted, adding enhanced combat behaviors for afflicted Pawns and a new, simpler way to cure it), and the Dark Arisen Expansion arriving October 9, it’ll be one of the best times ever to discover, or get back into, Dragon’s Dogma 2, so let’s make an event of it!
If you haven’t yet, you can check out the full Patch notes HERE.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225443/8b8860d0b45413ac0973a5bce33eb5540474c163.jpg"]

Whether that discovery is for the first time as a new player, or stepping back into the boots of your Arisen and continuing your adventure as an existing player to play and enjoy the game with all the sweeping improvements the team have made, as well as preparing for what awaits in the expansion. Talking of preparation, here’s some guidance from Producer Oyama regarding the expansion content that was shared in our recent Community Q&A:

The recommended starting level for Forsaken Dominion is 40, while that of Lost Rites is 20. That said, these recommendations apply only to the beginning of each content. As players progress, the challenge gradually ramps up, and both experiences become increasingly demanding.

Since both contents can be accessed early in the main story—simply by speaking with Brant at the tavern after arriving in Vernworth—players are free to challenge them even below the recommended level. Ultimately, we’d like players to use those recommendations as a reference and choose their own path based on how they want to experience the game.

And let’s not forget about our ever-faithful Pawns! You should totally give yours a shoutout in the comments. Share some details about their Vocation, skills, level and Pawn ID so we can all get hiring for our parties! Also, if you have any tips for new players, pop those there too!

With the arrival of optimization improvements on PC via Dragon’s Dogma 2’s update, we’ve updated the system requirements. These updates apply to both the base Dragon’s Dogma 2 game, and the Dark Arisen Expansion:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225443/67c8ef503bcf53371a408bd891543de97b286af9.png"]
That wraps up our Arise Again post, thanks for taking the time to check it out!
Whether as a new or returning player, we hope you’ll join us to play and celebrate Dragon’s Dogma 2 at a very exciting time for the game ahead of the expansion’s launch on October 9.

In the meantime, if you haven’t already, feel free to check out our recent Community Q&A with Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen’s Director Kinoshita and Producer Oyama. It’s filled with some great info on what’s coming in the expansion:

notes.title: Ranked Integrity Update – Rookie Rank Exploit

items.text: We recently identified and quickly resolved an exploit that allowed some players, primarily on PlayStation 5, to enter Ranked matches as Rookie IV regardless of their actual rank.

notes.title: This caused several unintended advantages, including

items.text: No Ranked entry cost
Rookie-tier kill bonuses
Matchmaking Rating (MMR) being recorded as 0
RP earned during these matches still being added to the player's actual Ranked score
This created an unfair advantage and directly impacted the integrity of Ranked progression.

Our Anti-Cheat team identified the root cause and deployed a fix to prevent further abuse. We also conducted an investigation into accounts that benefited from this exploit and took enforcement action against players who deliberately and egregiously abused it.
A total of 906 accounts have been banned, with suspension lengths determined by the amount of RP gained through exploitation:
731 accounts were banned for 120 days for illegitimately amassing approximately 4,999 RP
107 accounts were banned for 240 days for illegitimately amassing 5,000–9,999 RP
67 accounts were banned for 365 days for illegitimately amassing 10,000+ RP
PC: 12
PlayStation: 848
Xbox: 44
Nintendo Switch 2: 2
Total RP deducted: 15,112,554

We recognize that some players may have encountered this issue unintentionally. Through our investigation, we were able to precisely identify cases of unintended interaction and distinguish them from deliberate abuse. Those accounts were not actioned.

Ranked integrity depends on a fair and consistent competitive environment. Exploits that undermine matchmaking, bypass Ranked entry requirements, or provide illegitimate progression will be investigated and actioned.
Our team will continue monitoring Ranked, looking for similar activity and addressing vulnerabilities that could be used to compromise competitive integrity.

This patch includes our accessibility update alongside a number of fixes for issues reported from the community.
1.7 marks the completion of a large rollout of accessibility features. These features can be accessed via the Accessibility menu and include:

Color Assist - A set of tools to provide color clarity to players who have trouble distinguishing some specific colors in the game. In addition to making puzzle colors a bit more vivid, we have also included separate systems to display color patterns, and an even more robust system that displays color labels for objects of inquiry.
Remapping - Yes! Key/button remapping is now supported for both keyboard and controller.
Cursor Set - Options for changing the opacity, style, and size of the game’s reticle and cursor (this is part of our new Motion Assist options.)

Invert Stroll - This is a feature that will allow players to invert the stroll button functionality. Inverting this means you will move at the faster stroll speed without needing to press/hold a button, and pressing/holding the stroll button will slow you down to a walk.

Motion Assist - A consolidated menu of features and settings aimed to reduce motion sickness and sensory conflict: Cursor/Reticle Settings, Look Sensitivity, Field of View, Smooth Look, and Stairs Skip (visually turn off spiral staircase travel.) Each feature is included along with our recommended setting adjustments.
The patch notes below will include spoilers for some rarer rooms and mechanics.
We have updated the save file architecture again on PS5 to further address an issue with some save files exceeding size limits.
As part of the Cursor features implemented above, we have redone the way the system handles changing cursors for a smoother visual experience when drafting, picking up items etc.

Fixed an issue that was occasionally displaying a phantom Upgrade Disk in the Security terminal list for some players.

Slightly adjusted some factors related to the way Upgrade Disk floorplans are randomly selected to allow for greater variety during challenge runs while simultaneously making it less likely for new players from getting offered upgrades for rooms they have never drafted.
Fixed several bugs related to Powered Duct animations which restored spinning ducts to several rooms. Changing the direction of power in the Boiler Room also no longer breaks these animations.
Fixed several routing related bugs that could cause certain details and areas of the grounds and house to not be visible when approaching from certain areas.
Fixed an animation glitch caused by pressing buttons in the Chamber of Mirrors a bit too quickly that led to unexpected panel behaviour.

Fixed a handful of issues that were previously preventing floorplans from being duplicated by Chamber of Mirrors (some rooms are still excluded for technical reasons but the list is now more extensive.)
Related to the above - the experimental trigger related to terminal access has been reworked to correctly deal with duplicated terminal rooms.
A stamp in the Mail Room no longer disappears during magnification when a letter is in the foreground.
Fixed a bug that shut the book whenever you would click on the checkout card of A New Clue instead of inspecting it.
Fixed a bug that was unintentionally increasing the likelihood of drawing a non-green room in addition to the intended Green Rooms after Greenhouse had been drafted.
Fixed a bug with a particular locker in locker room that was occasionally not reacting to interaction.
Fixed a UI typo of “Bedroom” in an item description.
Fixed a text mesh bug that was not rendering asterisks correctly on a late grade chalkboard.
Updated templating of Observatory’s floorplan text to be more technically accurate and consistent with the game’s templating. (The floorplan now simply has the text “+1 star”)
Fixed incorrect layer assignments on a few more textures causing them to not be rendered when viewed through the magnifying glass.
Added more descriptive clarity for rarity in the wrench UI during first time use.

items.text: Fixed a rare bug in the Conservatory that was offering players options from “studio floorplans” and “found floorplans” that they had not added to their draft pools.
Added a redundancy check to address a glitch which was causing some challenge mode save files to incorrectly load in Bequest mode.
Fixed a corner case material glitch that related to the blessing of the monk that would sometimes affect the art at the bottom of the Foundation.
Fixed a sacred bug that only accepted the PM but not the AM.
Finally fixed a troublesome late game bug that was causing the drafting system to regard one very rare room as a color it clearly was not.
Fixed a bug causing boat travel to occasionally not be persistent between days if the cutscene was skipped.
Fixed a bug caused by exiting door UI during special key use animation in an underground area.
Addressed reports of clipping through the floor in a very late-game area by adding additional safety measures.
Fixed some issues that were causing unintended step loss and unintentioned geometry overlapping in that same area.
Fixed some uvmap texture issues in two of the illustrations in that same area. 🐌🎼
Gambit of the Queen has been rebalanced to grant the player an additional key per trigger.

Due to several known bugs and issues with R_y_l Sc____r (some of which rendered the item functionless), this item’s design has been subtly changed and expanded. The game will now allow players to set the color an additional time per day from the inventory menu, and the method the player “keeps” the item has also been tweaked.
This patch will follow for Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and App Store players. Each platform has varying timescales for approving patches and we expect this to reach players by late next week.
